fusions.name: Spokes Fan Out
fusions.desc: Thrusts a fan of spokes ahead of you that deals 12 damage to everything in a cone 3.5 tiles long. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Twin-Prong Reckoning
fusions.desc: Hurls a spinning two-tined bolt that deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets. It uses up every affliction you have on that enemy, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Turned Both Ways
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the elemental damage you take is turned back on whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Splitting Tine
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, a bolt splits off to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
